fetch_recipe: GET the recorded url exactly (raw Internet Archive id_ form) with no Accept-Encoding request header and no automatic decoding (for example curl -s -o FILE URL, without --compressed), then hash the bytes as received. A client that sends Accept-Encoding can receive an on-the-fly gzip body with different bytes, and a decoding client unpacks bodies that the archive stores compressed.

rows.text: The statement issued on "25 Oct 2019" says "The Federal Leader and Federal Chairperson positions became vacant on Wednesday following the personal decision of Mmusi Maimane and Athol Trollip to resign from their positions".
The same statement says a special Federal Council meeting will "elect an Interim Federal Leader and Interim Federal Chairperson" and that "The election will take place on Sunday, 17 November 2019".
